requirements.description: Compustat annual event-year accounting variables, auditor-opinion code, SIC, auditor and firm identifiers for all baseline fits.

required_coverage.population: 1980–1997 qualified-report event firms and matched clean controls; also the larger support-fit populations
required_coverage.detail: Fields support TA, BP, MKTCAP, DE, PERFORM, auditor opinion and matching. The earliest time-series Jones event is 1980; its eight-year fit begins 1972, and within-fit predictor lags require 1971 values. The paper nevertheless says 1972 is the first available data year.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog labels and exact probe verify annual fields corresponding to the paper’s Compustat items and explicit opinion coding. `auop` codes 1/2 are specified by the paper.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the 1971–1997 event, fit and matched-control populations; paper vintage starts at 1972, creating a one-year support-fit boundary tension.

requirements.description: Apply the 1980–1997 event-year sample restrictions and match 173 qualified firms to 173 clean controls on year, two-digit SIC industry, auditor type and nearest total assets.

required_coverage.population: Initial Compustat observations screened for qualified opinion, one qualification per firm, complete/nonnegative accounting controls and classifiable SIC; final 173 matched pairs
required_coverage.detail: The source reports 112,384 initial firm-years, then staged exclusions, 173 unique qualified firms, and 173 controls. The exact nearest-assets tie-break and auditor-type crosswalk are not supplied.

routes.mapping_notes: Fields support opinion, industry, auditor and size matching; the auditor-type classification and nearest-asset tie rule remain unspecified.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Exact match-pair construction and screening history cannot be verified from the bounded field probe or without a complete sample/population confirmation.

requirements.description: Firm-specific time-series Jones OLS support fits for each event-year firm using the eight annual observations ending immediately before the event year, plus event-year DA raw measures.

required_coverage.population: All event firms with the required pre-event eight-year history, before the later baseline missing-value and matched-pair screens
required_coverage.detail: For event year t, fit rows are t−8 through t−1; each row’s ΔTA and ΔRevenue predictors use t−1 values, so raw inputs begin t−9. For 1980 events this means fit years 1972–1979 and raw years back to 1971.

routes.mapping_notes: The Jones OLS dependent variable and predictor fields are present. An eight-year per-firm estimation population is distinct from the final 173 matched pairs.
routes.coverage_notes: A bounded probe verifies access and columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied for this resource and required period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coverage confirmation establishes complete per-firm eight-year histories. The stated 1972 first-year availability conflicts with the lagged 1971 raw balance/revenue values required for 1980 fits.

requirements.description: Cross-sectional Jones support-fit rows within each event-year × two-digit SIC cell.

required_coverage.frequency: annual firm-year observations by event year and 2-digit SIC cell
required_coverage.population: All firms in each event-year × two-digit SIC estimation cell before applying the final matched qualified/control screen; exact cell population requires confirmation
required_coverage.detail: Support models use current-year and lagged annual fields. The event-year 1980 cell requires 1979 lag data. The source reports variable cell sizes and a median fit N, not a common population cutoff.

Absolute firm-specific Jones discretionary accrual at fiscal year-end of the event year: observed total accruals scaled by assets at year-end t−1 minus nondiscretionary accruals predicted by the original Jones model. TA_t = change in current assets (#4) − change in cash and cash equivalents (#1) − change in current liabilities (#5) + change in debt included in current liabilities (#34) − depreciation and amortization expense (#14), all in year t. ΔREV is revenues in year t less revenues in year t−1; PPE is gross property, plant, and equipment at year-end t; A is total assets at year-end t−1. Coefficients are firm-specific and estimated by OLS using the eight years ending immediately before the event year. Raw inputs/construction: COMP.FUNDA fields gvkey, datadate, fyear, sich, au, auop, at, act, che, lct, dlc, dp, revt, rect, ppegt, ceq, csho, prcc_f, dltt, ib; COMP.FUNDA fields gvkey, datadate, fyear, at, act, che, lct, dlc, dp, revt, ppegt.

review_notes: Baseline event fiscal years are 1980–1997. Cross-sectional cells use t and t−1, requiring 1979–1997. Preserve support populations before the later event/control screens.
